name: Set
body:
To gain rulership for himself, Set murdered his own brother, which earned him the titles of Sower of Discord and Father of Jackals. Set is the patron of rivalry, betrayal, and disorder.

Set appears as a human male with the head of a set animal. A set animal has a long, downward-curving snout, long ears with squared-off ends, four legs, and a thin, forked tail that ends in tufts of fur. Murderers, betrayers, and thieves appeal to Set for his blessings.

Rivalry

Granted Powers: Your magic augments your martial prowess, making you a force to be reckoned with. You never pass up the opportunity to stir up trouble, and it is a matter of pride for you to wrest power from another.

One on One (Ex)

When you make a melee attack or combat maneuver against a creature and there are no allies adjacent to you, you can use a swift action to grant yourself a +1 morale bonus to the attack roll or to your CMB. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

What’s Yours Is Mine (Ex)

Beginning at 8th level, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity when you attempt a dirty trick, steal, or disarm combat maneuver. Furthermore, you can use a swift action to grant yourself a +2 sacred bonus to your CMB when attempting these maneuvers. You can grant yourself this bonus 3 times per day.

Domain: 1st-stunning barrier, 2nd-inflict moderate wounds, 3rd-stunning barrier, greater, 4th-hellmouth lash, 5th-resounding blow, 6thharm, 7th-dance of a thousand cuts, 8thspellcrash, greater, 9th-crushing hand.
